documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sheetal Universal Limited reported a decrease in revenue for the financial year 2024-25 compared to the previous year, while profit increased significantly. The company operates in the agricultural products segment and is focusing on quality, innovation, and expanding its market reach. Management has implemented internal control systems and is committed to maintaining high standards of corporate governance. The company also declared a final dividend of Rs. 0.5 per equity share for the year ended March 31, 2025.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects strong demand for its agricultural products in both domestic and international markets in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects potential demand for its agricultural products in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: As ours is the agriculture based products, there is lot of potential demand for the next years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company installed new machinery to improve results and meet changing industry requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is looking for new products and machinery for expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Also company is come up with IPO in f.y. 2023-24 and looks for new products and machinery for expansion.

margins_costs.claim: The company is taking initiatives to improve quality standards and reduce costs.
margins_costs.quote: The initiatives are being taken by the Company for improving the quality standards and reduction of costs at appropriate level.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 20.05% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 20.05 % as compared to previous year

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.5 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to retain the entire profit for the financial year 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board decided not to recommend any dividend for the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances and keeping in view the Company’s dividend track, has decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend for the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in the Rupee price and raw material costs, along with stringent market conditions, pose risks to the company's performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Major fluctuations Rupee price value corresponding to fluctuation in the raw material price and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to operate on a larger scale and capture a higher portion of market demand.
management_commitments.quote: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
